'''''Xesre''''' was a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] serving the [[Mugaari pirates]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it was present at a [[Mugaari cargo loading area|cargo loading area]] in the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]] during an arms deal between the Muggaari and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. It was destroyed in the ensuing [[Battle of the Tungra sector]] against Imperial forces along with all the other Mugaari ships.
